description: (Na)₂LiYCl₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a LiYCl₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the LiYCl₆ framework, Li is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form LiCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent YCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Li-Cl bond lengths are 2.52 Å. Y is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form YCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Y-Cl bond lengths are 2.62 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Li and one Y atom.
